channel.title: FlamingPiston
channel.description: Honest automotive reviews, practical buying advice, and maintenance guides.

item.title: Audi Q3 Debuts in India: 204hp, Quattro AWD
item.description: The third-gen Audi Q3 has debuted in India, launching this festive season with a 204hp 2.0 TFSI petrol and Quattro AWD. Price expected around Rs 60 lakh.

item.title: Brezza Turbo vs 1.5 Petrol: Which to Buy
item.description: 2026 Brezza 1.0 turbo (110PS) vs 1.5 petrol (103PS) on power, mileage and price. Turbo's cheaper and stronger but manual-only — here's the catch.

item.title: Kia Sorento India Launch: Hybrid, Diesel & AWD
item.description: Kia Sorento launches in India on September 4 with a 238 PS strong-hybrid, 2.2L diesel, AWD and 3-row seating. Starting price around ₹40 lakh.

item.title: Nexon Camo Edition: ₹9.99L, ADAS & Dashcam
item.description: Tata Nexon Camo Edition launched at ₹9.99 lakh — two exclusive colours, 12.3-inch screen, integrated dashcam and ADAS. Petrol, diesel and CNG.

item.title: 2026 Mercedes-Benz S-Class Launched in India: First PHEV S-Class, ₹2.20 Crore
item.description: The 2026 Mercedes-Benz S-Class facelift is now in India. It's PHEV-only at ₹2.20–2.38 crore, with 115 km EV range, MBUX Superscreen, and 15 airbags.

item.title: 2026 Maruti Brezza CNG Review: Mileage, Ownership & Is It Worth It?
item.description: The 2026 Brezza CNG finally gets an underbody tank — no more butchered boot. Here's what that actually means, what it costs, and who should buy it.

item.title: BMW X5 vs Genesis GV80 vs Volvo XC90: Which Luxury SUV Should You Buy?
item.description: Three very different answers to the same question. The BMW X5 drives, the Genesis GV80 overdelivers, the Volvo XC90 reassures. Here's which one is actually right for you.

item.title: BMW i5 Long Wheelbase Launched in India: 669 km Range, Local Assembly, 99-Unit First Edition
item.description: BMW India opens bookings for the i5 LWB — locally assembled at Chennai, 669 km MIDC range, and a 99-unit First Edition already live.

item.title: Genesis GV90 Revealed: Coach Doors, Cinema Cabin, Europe's Largest Electric SUV
item.description: Genesis has unveiled the GV90 flagship electric SUV — coach doors, no B-pillar, 800V platform, and a price that takes aim at Rolls-Royce and Bentley.

item.title: 2027 Hyundai Tucson Revealed: Art of Steel Design, Fully Electrified Powertrain Range
item.description: Fifth-generation Hyundai Tucson officially revealed — sharper Art of Steel design, Pleos OS with Gleo AI, and an electrified-only powertrain range. India launch expected 2027.

item.title: Land Rover Defender Dakar Revealed: 626HP Road-Legal Rally Beast
item.description: Land Rover has revealed the Defender Dakar, a limited-run road-legal version of its Dakar Rally-winning D7X-R, with a 626hp V8 and rally-derived chassis.

item.title: Skoda Octavia RS Second Batch: Pre-Bookings Open, Deliveries This Festive Season
item.description: Skoda has reopened Octavia RS bookings for a second India batch, with deliveries slated for festive season 2026. Here's what's confirmed so far.

item.title: Skoda Superb TDI Confirmed for India: Pre-Bookings Open, Deliveries in Q2 2027
item.description: Skoda has opened pre-bookings for a diesel-powered Superb in India, marking the brand's first TDI model here in years. Deliveries begin Q2 2027.

item.title: 2026 Maruti Brezza vs Fronx: Which One Should You Buy?
item.description: Brezza vs Fronx compared on price, mileage, safety, and features, starting with the fact most comparisons bury: the automatic gearbox you want isn't paired with the engine you want on either car.

item.title: Skoda Slavia Facelift Review 2026: Verdict
item.description: 2026 Skoda Slavia facelift review — new 8-speed auto, 10.25-inch display, up to 6 airbags, 521L boot. Is it worth buying?

item.title: Skoda Slavia Facelift vs Volkswagen Virtus: Which Should You Buy? (2026)
item.description: Slavia facelift vs Virtus compared: same MQB A0 IN platform, nearly identical engines, but one real mechanical difference decides this right now.

item.title: Tata Altroz Review (2026): Price, Mileage, Safety & Is It Worth Buying?
item.description: Tata Altroz review 2026: price, mileage, 5-star safety rating, CNG AMT option, and whether India's safest premium hatchback is worth buying.

item.title: Aston Martin Valen Unveiled: 850PS V12, World's Most Powerful Front-Engined Car (2026)
item.description: Aston Martin has revealed the Valen, an 850PS twin-turbo V12 special limited to 150 units, now the world's most powerful front-engined production car.

item.title: 2026 Maruti Brezza Automatic Review: Is the Torque Converter AT Worth It?
item.description: Brezza 2026 automatic review — the 6-speed torque converter costs ₹1.5L more than manual. Is the smoother drive worth it? Real-world mileage, drive feel & our verdict.

item.title: Mahindra BE 6 Sporteq Launched at ₹19.45 Lakh, Triple-Screen Cockpit (2026)
item.description: Mahindra has launched the BE 6 Sporteq from ₹19.45 lakh (₹11.45 lakh with BaaS), with a triple-screen cockpit, Google Gemini integration, and two special editions.
